fields.description: When recording began.

fields.label: Stopped At
fields.description: When recording stopped.

fields.label: Steps to Reproduce / Notes
fields.description: Describe what you did during this session, step by step, so your dev team (or an outside reviewer) can reproduce it alongside the technical findings. It is also a good place for related ticket links. This shows at the top of the report and you can edit it even after the session is Ready.

fields.label: Findings
fields.description: The performance problems found in this session.

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: The user actions and requests captured, in the order they happened.
The background jobs the recorded flow kicked off, each with its status (completed, failed, timed out or still running).
fields.label: Background Jobs

fields.description: The Phase 2 line-profiling runs attached to this session. Each row is one drill-down pass into the hot lines.
fields.label: Phase 2 Runs

fields.description: The running total of AI tokens billed for this session, covering the automatic suggestions during analyze plus every Refresh or on-demand AI run. It matches the Aerele usage ledger and only ever goes up.
fields.label: AI Tokens Spent

fields.description: This counts how many times "Refresh AI suggestions" has been run on this session.
fields.label: AI Refresh Count

fields.description: This counts the AI tokens used to rewrite this session's Steps to Reproduce into plain language. Internal bookkeeping, counted as part of the session's total AI tokens in the report.
fields.label: AI Steps Tokens
Analyze Duration (ms)
fields.description: This records how long the analyze step took, in milliseconds. Handy for keeping an eye on the profiler's own health.
A compressed JSON snapshot of the raw recordings (already redacted when captured). It lets AI re-runs and report drill-downs still work after the live recording has been cleared from Redis.
fields.label: Recordings Snapshot
